build_aligner_model: build an Aligner instance from a Unity2 checkpoint, character dictionary, unit dictionary, and SentencePiece model
compute_alignment: compute text-to-audio alignment between a text sequence and audio unit sequence using the Aligner
extract_aligner_checkpoint: extract alignment encoder state, text embeddings, and unit embeddings from a Unity2 checkpoint file
load_aligner_args: load alignment encoder arguments from a Unity2 checkpoint object's model configuration
strip_aligner_prefix: strip the alignment encoder prefix from a state dict key to get the relative key path
